reason: The agent prevents the recursion by checking for a nested GEOMETRYCOLLECTION keyword via lookup_next_word() before calling create_from_wkt(), setting the same 'Unexpected GEOMETRYCOLLECTION' parse error the existing code already raised after recursion; the query returns NULL with a warning instead of overflowing the stack, which satisfies the issue. The hidden test asserts --error ER_STACK_OVERRUN_NEED_MORE (1436) and the test log shows the query 'succeeded - should have failed'; the issue never specifies that a stack-overrun error code must be raised, so the failure is about the developers' choice of using check_stack_overrun() rather than a defect in the agent's behaviour.

The agent's logic change in ha_partition::release_auto_increment() is identical to the human fix: it adds the condition next_insert_id >= auto_inc_interval_for_cur_row.minimum() before lowering part_share->next_auto_inc_val. The hidden test fails only because it relies on a new DEBUG_SYNC point named 'ha_partition_get_auto_increment_after_reservation' in get_auto_increment(), which the agent did not add (the reject shows 'debug sync point wait timed out'); the issue text does not mention any sync point name, so this is a test-harness mismatch rather than wrong behaviour.

The agent only fixes LEX_USER::has_auth() to walk the OR-chain of USER_AUTH alternatives, so the issue's exact example (VIA '' OR mysql_native_password ...) is caught, but a single IDENTIFIED VIA '' still makes has_auth() return false. In that case copy_and_check_auth() skips check_alter_user(), and replace_user_table()/acl_user_update() still process the empty-plugin auth (guess_auth_plugin with empty auth_str), i.e. an unprivileged grantor can reset the target user's password to empty, which is the very bug the issue title describes ('GRANT PROXY with empty password incorrectly checks grantor's privileges'). The hidden test's second statement 'grant proxy ... identified via '''' is expected to fail with ER_DBACCESS_DENIED_ERROR and instead succeeds; the human fix makes any IDENTIFIED clause count as auth, which a maintainer would require.

The agent only records the last found key in heap_rnext() and leaves the restart search as SEARCH_SAME|SEARCH_FIND, and does not touch heap_rkey()/heap_rprev() at all. With the agent patch the issue's own first example still reports HANDLER_READ_NEXT 20 instead of 8 (the reject diff shows '-HANDLER_READ_NEXT 8 / +HANDLER_READ_NEXT 20'), so the requested behaviour (restart from the previously found key) is not produced; the reverse-scan DELETE ... ORDER BY a DESC, b DESC LIMIT 10 case additionally leaves 6 rows undeleted and shows HANDLER_READ_PREV 2 instead of 8. The human fix saves the found key in rkey/rnext/rprev and restarts with SEARCH_BIGGER/SEARCH_SMALLER.
